text: I had braces here for crooked teeth and a deep bite. I wore braces for 3 years, and when they were removed, my deep bite was still there. The dentist was so brave to remove them in that condition! I'm sure I'll need a second round of braces. It's been 6 years now. I wouldn't recommend it. I just wanted to share a real-life review.
